Source name of a FUNDEB sheet

Source: R/get-fundeb.R
fundeb_sheet_source.Rd

Internal function. The sheet name is the destination prefix (E_ for states, M_ for municipalities) followed by the source. The VAAF, VAAT and VAAR shares of the Complementacao da Uniao (E_COUN_VAAF) keep the short name ("VAAF"); every other sheet keeps its full suffix (E_COUN -> "COUN", E_AFE_EC123 -> "AFE_EC123").

Usage

fundeb_sheet_source(sheet)

Arguments

sheet

A sheet name.

Value

A string.
